userStories.title: Standardize TanStack Query configuration with shared cache tiers and query key factory
userStories.description: As a developer, I need consistent TanStack Query caching across all hooks so that data freshness is predictable and cache keys don't collide or create duplicate entries.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/queryConfig.ts with shared staleTime tiers: INSTANT (0), SHORT (30s), MEDIUM (5min), LONG (30min)
Create src/lib/queryKeys.ts with a query key factory pattern for events, restaurants, attractions, favorites, and search
Update useEvents, useRestaurants, useAttractions hooks to use shared staleTime tiers and query key factory
Update useFavorites to use explicit staleTime (currently uses implicit default) and query key factory
Add refetchOnMount: false to expensive query hooks (search, recommendations) to prevent refetch on navigation back
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PERFORMANCE AUDIT: staleTime values are inconsistent across hooks — useSubscription uses 5min, useFavorites uses default 60s, useEnhancedSearch uses 30s/5min/10min in different places. Query keys like ['favorites', user?.id] create duplicate entries when user?.id is undefined. A shared config prevents cache misses and the query key factory prevents key collisions.

userStories.title: Defer Three.js loading on homepage to unblock First Contentful Paint
userStories.description: As a user, I need the homepage to paint content immediately without waiting for the 600KB+ Three.js library so that I see useful content within 1 second instead of waiting 3+ seconds.
acceptanceCriteria: Update Hero3D.tsx to defer Three.js and React Three Fiber imports until after initial paint using a useEffect-gated lazy import
Show a lightweight CSS gradient placeholder hero while Three.js loads (not a blank space or loading spinner)
Wrap the Three.js Canvas component in React.Suspense with the gradient placeholder as fallback
Add React.memo to Hero3D to prevent unnecessary re-renders
Verify FCP improves by measuring with Lighthouse before/after
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PERFORMANCE AUDIT: Hero3D imports Three.js (~600KB) at module evaluation time. If rendered on the homepage (likely), this blocks First Contentful Paint by 300-500ms. The fix is to show a CSS-only placeholder and load Three.js asynchronously after paint. This is the single biggest FCP improvement available.

userStories.title: Add useCallback to event handlers passed to memoized list item components
userStories.description: As a developer, I need stable callback references for event handlers passed to React.memo'd card components so that memo actually prevents re-renders in list views with 20-40 items.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit EventsPage.tsx, Restaurants.tsx, Attractions.tsx for inline arrow functions passed as props to card components
Wrap all callback props (onViewDetails, onFavorite, onShare) with useCallback and explicit dependency arrays
Verify EventCard's React.memo wrapper actually prevents re-renders by adding a React DevTools Profiler check
Apply the same useCallback pattern to RestaurantCard and AttractionCard parents
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PERFORMANCE AUDIT: EventCard uses React.memo but parent passes inline arrow functions () => action(event) on every render. This creates new function references each time, defeating memo. With 20-40 cards per page, every parent state change (filter toggle, search keystroke) re-renders all cards. Wrapping handlers in useCallback is a 200-500ms improvement on list views.

userStories.title: Add empty states with contextual actions to all listing pages
userStories.description: As a user, I need clear, helpful empty states when searches or filters return no results so that I know what to do next instead of seeing a blank white page.
acceptanceCriteria: Use the existing EmptyState component (src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx) on EventsPage when no events match filters/search
Use EmptyState on Restaurants.tsx when no restaurants match filters
Use EmptyState on Attractions.tsx when no attractions match filters
Each empty state must include: relevant icon, descriptive title, helpful description, and a 'Clear Filters' or 'Browse All' action button
Add empty states to user favorites page ('No favorites yet — explore events to add some')

userStories.notes: UI/UX AUDIT: The EmptyState component exists (src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx) but is not used on any listing page. When search/filter returns 0 results, users see blank white space. This is confusing — users think the page is broken. Contextual empty states with clear CTAs improve discoverability and reduce bounce rates.

userStories.title: Add search autocomplete with recent searches and suggestions
userStories.description: As a user, I need search autocomplete showing popular suggestions and my recent searches so that I can find content faster without guessing exact keywords.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/components/SearchAutocomplete.tsx that renders a dropdown below the search input with sections: Recent Searches, Suggested Results
Store recent searches (last 10) in safeStorage, scoped per content type (events, restaurants, attractions)
Query database for title matches as user types (debounced, 3+ characters) and show top 5 suggestions

Clear recent searches button in the dropdown
Keyboard accessible: arrow keys navigate suggestions, Enter selects, Escape closes dropdown

userStories.notes: UI/UX AUDIT: Search inputs on all listing pages have debouncing (US-036) but no autocomplete, no recent searches, and no suggestions. Users have to know exactly what they're searching for. Autocomplete dramatically improves search conversion — users see matching titles as they type, reducing failed searches.

Additionally, multiple components have hardcoded colors without dark: variants — RestaurantCard gradients, ShareDialog platform buttons, and BottomNav hover states don't adapt to dark mode.

userStories.title: Add context-aware loading states and error recovery to listing pages

Add loading spinners to favorite/unfavorite buttons that disable during mutation
Show upload progress percentage (not just spinner) in EventSubmissionForm.tsx

userStories.notes: UI/UX AUDIT: Loading states use generic labels ('Loading content...') regardless of context. Error states are incomplete — network failures on search don't show user-friendly recovery options. Mutation buttons (favorite, share) don't show loading state, so users can't tell if their click registered.

The pagination.tsx component exists in src/components/ui/ but is never imported on any listing page. Large result sets render all items, causing performance degradation.

Add onMouseEnter prefetch triggers to Header.tsx navigation links

Missing DNS prefetch hints for Stripe. Expanding prefetch to all popular routes saves 200-500ms per navigation.

userStories.title: Wire FAQSchema to FAQ sections and add FAQ structured data to key pages

Verify FAQ structured data validates via Google Rich Results Test

userStories.title: Replace raw img tags with OptimizedImage component and add aspect ratio wrappers
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all content images to use the OptimizedImage component with consistent aspect ratios so that images are lazy-loaded, WebP-optimized, and don't cause Cumulative Layout Shift.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace raw tags in EventCard.tsx with OptimizedImage component, using width={400} height={250} and aspect ratio wrapper
Replace raw tags in RestaurantCard.tsx with OptimizedImage
Add aspect-[3/2] or aspect-video wrapper div around all card images to prevent CLS
Set loading='eager' on above-fold hero images and loading='lazy' on all below-fold content
Add srcSet with responsive widths (320w, 400w, 800w) for mobile optimization
Verify CLS score improves by measuring with Lighthouse before/after
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PERFORMANCE AUDIT: EventCard.tsx uses raw tags instead of the existing OptimizedImage component. No aspect ratio wrappers mean images cause layout shift as they load. Card images load full-resolution (~800KB) instead of thumbnail sizes. On mobile list views, this wastes 2-5MB of bandwidth per page. The OptimizedImage component already exists and handles lazy loading, WebP, and error states.

userStories.title: Add interactive map accessibility with skip link and keyboard alternative
userStories.description: As a screen reader user, I need an accessible alternative to the interactive Leaflet map so that I can discover the same location-based content without needing to interact with a visual map.
acceptanceCriteria: Add role='application' and aria-label to the InteractiveMap component's container div
Add a visible 'Skip map, view as list' button before the map that scrolls to a list view of the same data
Ensure map markers have aria-label with the entity name and type
Add a keyboard-accessible list view alternative showing the same data as the map with sortable columns
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: ACCESSIBILITY AUDIT: Leaflet maps are notoriously inaccessible to screen reader users. The InteractiveMap component lacks role, aria-label, and any keyboard alternative. Users who can't interact with the visual map have no way to access the location-based content it displays. WCAG 1.1.1 requires a text alternative for all non-text content.

Ensure toast messages are concise and actionable: 'Added to favorites' not 'The item has been successfully added to your favorites list'

Long operations like image upload show spinners but no toast. Mobile users may not see bottom-positioned toasts due to BottomNav overlap.

userStories.title: Add login attempt throttling to prevent brute force attacks
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need login attempts throttled per IP and per email so that brute force password attacks are mitigated.
acceptanceCriteria: Add login attempt tracking: max 5 failed attempts per email per 15 minutes, max 20 failed attempts per IP per 15 minutes
After limit exceeded, return 429 with Retry-After header and show user-friendly message: 'Too many login attempts. Please try again in X minutes.'
Track attempts in a login_attempts table or rate limit store (from US-073)
Reset attempt counter on successful login
Log excessive failed attempts for security monitoring
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: SECURITY AUDIT: No login attempt throttling exists. Supabase Auth handles authentication but edge functions don't add any additional rate limiting on auth endpoints. userStories.title: Separate service worker caches and add image cache persistence across deploys
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the service worker to use separate cache buckets for runtime assets, images, and API responses so that deploys don't invalidate the image cache users have already built up.
acceptanceCriteria: Split public/sw.js caches into: dmi-runtime-v{n} (cleared on deploy), dmi-images-v1 (persists across deploys), dmi-api-v1 (persists with TTL)
Only clear the runtime cache on activate event — preserve image and API caches
Add 7-day expiration to cached images to prevent stale content
Add 5-minute expiration to cached API responses
Ensure offline.html is properly cached and served when network is unavailable
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PERFORMANCE AUDIT: Service worker uses a single cache version (v4) that invalidates ALL cached content on every deploy — including images users have already downloaded. Separating caches means deploys only bust the runtime cache while preserving the image cache, saving users from re-downloading megabytes of already-seen images.

userStories.title: Add prefers-reduced-motion support across all animations

Disable Three.js/React Three Fiber hero animation when reduced motion is preferred
Disable auto-advancing carousels or slideshows when reduced motion is preferred
Create useReducedMotion() hook that returns boolean for component-level motion checks

However the accessibility audit found that prefers-reduced-motion support is still incomplete in practice — animations defined in Tailwind config (16 animations) don't have motion-reduce variants, and the Three.js hero may not be fully disabled. This story ensures completeness.

Update EventCard.tsx getCategoryColor() to use the shared CATEGORY_COLORS map
Update RestaurantCard.tsx cuisine badge colors to use the shared map
Standardize card image heights, padding, and font sizes across all card types

AttractionCard likely has yet another color system. This inconsistency confuses users — the same category appears in different colors depending on the card type. A shared constant map ensures visual consistency.

Add Origin header validation — reject requests from unlisted origins with 403

userStories.notes: SECURITY AUDIT: stripe-webhook/index.ts has Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * which is dangerous for any endpoint. Webhooks don't need CORS at all — they're called server-to-server by Stripe. Other edge functions should also be audited to ensure they don't use wildcard CORS.

userStories.title: Implement optimistic updates for favorites, ratings, and attendance mutations
userStories.description: As a user, I need favorite/unfavorite, rating, and attendance actions to update the UI instantly without waiting for the server response so that interactions feel snappy, especially on mobile or slow networks.
acceptanceCriteria: Add onMutate optimistic update to useFavorites.ts addFavoriteMutation and removeFavoriteMutation: snapshot previous state, optimistically update query cache, return rollback context
Add onError rollback to both favorite mutations: restore previous state from context on server failure
Add onMutate optimistic update to useRatings.ts for rating submission
Add onMutate optimistic update to useEventSocial.ts for attendance RSVP
Verify that UI updates instantly on click, then reconciles with server response
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: DATA LAYER AUDIT: No mutation in the codebase uses TanStack Query's optimistic update pattern (onMutate + rollback). Users currently wait for the full server round-trip before seeing UI changes — toggling a favorite takes 300-800ms of visible delay. Optimistic updates make this instant with automatic rollback on failure.

userStories.title: Add detail page data prefetching on card hover for instant navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I need detail page data to start loading when I hover over a card so that clicking through feels instant instead of showing a loading spinner.
acceptanceCriteria: Add onMouseEnter handler to EventCard that prefetches event detail data via queryClient.prefetchQuery
Add onMouseEnter handler to RestaurantCard that prefetches restaurant detail data
Add onMouseEnter handler to AttractionCard that prefetches attraction detail data
Use requestIdleCallback to avoid blocking the main thread during prefetch
Prefetch should only trigger once per card (debounce/guard against repeated hover)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: DATA LAYER AUDIT: Route-level prefetching exists (src/lib/prefetch.ts) but only prefetches code bundles, not data. When a user clicks a card, they wait for both the route bundle AND the API data to load. Prefetching data on hover means the API response is already cached when the user clicks, making navigation feel instant.
